title: Webb County Commissioners Court special meeting set for Wednesday, Nov. 18
excerpt: Webb County Commissioners Court will hold a special meeting at 8:15 a.m. on Wednesday, Nov. 18, on the second floor of the Webb County Courthouse, 1000 Houston Street, with the agenda posted online and a live stream available.
content:
Webb County Commissioners Court will hold a special meeting at 8:15 a.m. on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, on the second floor of the Webb County Courthouse, 1000 Houston Street, according to Webb County.

The meeting agenda is posted online at tinyurl.com/WebbAgenda, the county said.

Residents who cannot attend in person can watch the meeting live at tinyurl.com/WebbStreamLive, according to the county.

Source: Webb County, Texas (Facebook), Nov. 13, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
